gallery.headline: Pick a point of view, not a pile of CSS.
gallery.lede: AgentSam prebuilds are complete starting points with real navigation, responsive behavior, content structure, and interaction patterns. Swap the story, keep the machinery.
gallery.discover_copy: Start with the mood that fits. Every prebuild is meant to be rewritten, re-skinned, and connected to real content — not treated like a locked demo.
gallery.seo_title: AgentSam Prebuilds — Production-ready website starting points
gallery.seo_description: Explore AgentSam prebuilt website themes for commerce, professional services, nonprofits, local services, portfolios, and editorial storefronts.
